Warehouse inventory review — Orchard Yard
Recorded 12 March, 68 minutes. Diarized locally; the audio never left the machine.
Timestamps are elapsed time from the start of the recording.
==========================================================================

[00:00:00] Ada Sterling:
    right, we are recording. walk me through where the count actually breaks.

[00:00:11] Bo Marek:
    the count breaks at the door, not in the racks. a pallet arrives, the driver

    scans it, and then it sits on the apron for anywhere between ten minutes and

    two hours before anyone assigns it a bin.

    during that window the system says we have it and the floor says we do not.

[00:00:48] Ada Sterling:
    so the discrepancy is a timing artefact rather than shrinkage?

[00:01:02] Bo Marek:
    mostly. we measured it over a quarter — café deliveries, naïve counts, the lot —
    and about eighty per cent of the gap closed itself within four hours.

[01:04:30] Ada Sterling:
    that is the number I would lead with. what would it take to close the rest?

[01:07:15] Bo Marek:
    a handheld that forces a bin assignment before the driver leaves the apron.
